consumer: The find-item quest's possession/objective gate, asking whether the engine considers the flashlight possessed at the quest's required reach (objective completion predicate).
scope: The find-item objective's required reach over the character's full reachable inventory (including items nested inside worn containers and counted by charges/amount), as the engine's possession/objective predicate computes it.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, which flat-walks wielded_items/worn/inv_const_slice top-level stacks and re-derives possession from a partial view rather than returning the engine's objective predicate result.
divergence: The flashlight sits inside a worn backpack pocket (nested container contents): the engine's has_amount/charges_of objective predicate counts it as possessed, but the flat carried_items walk only emits top-level inventory stacks and misses it, so the gate reads 'not on character' when the quest says it is.
